sphere_commentary.overview:
The dataset reveals generally positive outcomes across all series, with distinctive consistency patterns.
• HEALING delivers the highest mean (6.98) and lowest variance, especially in anxiety and sleep protocols.
• THRIVING matches HEALING in mean (6.96) but shows higher variability, driven by focus and creative flow entries.
• TRANSFORMING averages lower (6.59) with the widest spread, reflecting its ascending‑arc design for low‑affect states.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
Series‑specific design intents are reflected in the observed efficacy signals.
• HEALING’s DESCENT architecture yields consistently high scores and tight std across entry types.
• THRIVING’s HOLD format achieves strong peaks (e.g., T‑FC‑L3) but also shows occasional spread in maintenance protocols.
• TRANSFORMING’s ASCENT/ DESCENT mix produces the greatest outcome variance, as anticipated for low‑energy targets.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
A few protocols display divergences between observed outcomes and model expectations.
• X‑ME‑L1, L2, L3 show AutoGluon predictions >1.3 points higher than observed means, signaling possible feature‑misalignment.
• T‑FC‑L3 records the highest observed mean (7.63) yet AutoGluon routes alternative protocols into its focus zone.
• Several protocols exhibit notable cross‑run drift (sim <0.7), suggesting evolving listener interpretations.
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
The data suggest concrete areas for protocol iteration.
• Increase the hold phase duration for T‑FC‑L3 (n=35) to smooth its high variance.
• Introduce an L2 variant of H‑CR‑L1 (n=43) to test whether a longer entrainment curve improves crisis outcomes.
• Re‑evaluate the rhythmic intensity of X‑MD‑L1 (n=22) given its large prediction‑outcome gap.
• Prioritize YouTube promotion for H‑OS‑L1 (n=95, 30 views) to leverage its strong efficacy with broader reach.
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Embedding signals indicate evolving analytical perspectives.
• CROSS‑RUN DRIFT: 28 of 30 protocols have cosine similarity below 0.7, highlighting substantial commentary shifts.
• CROSS‑PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: Insufficient embedding density to generate meaningful clusters.
• Confidence note: limited embedding coverage reduces the robustness of drift‑based interpretations.
